purpose: Qualify bounded checked preparation and a genuinely learned neural trial-level controller on independent question families, preserving the original overall criterion and adding equally strong direct meta controls.

pilot.evaluation: development only; no final confirmation inference

common: Identical materialized fresh lower model/Adam and same seven question-only self-discovered helper inputs per final seed. All adaptive arms additionally share the exact first48 own acquisition records, feedback and replay BEFORE any optimizer update, removing preparation-independent timing divergence. That measured common acquisition cost is charged to each adaptive arm ceiling, physically incurred once. The original random+balanced comparator keeps its own random first48. Every branch has at most96 own questions and500 candidate updates.
task_owner: Maintained Frontier::refresh/candidates/choose with ordinary formal prefilter; newly admitted own Graph artifacts may propose bounded continuations. State feedback is updated from each own bounded search and complete development qualification, then used by the next selection. Each arm attempts a native question identity at most once in this finite comparison; this control does not replace production cooldown/retry policy.
knowledge_control: Per-seed common definitions and theorem dictionary stay fixed in all arms; new own checked discoveries affect task proposals and replay. This isolates sampling and preparation from dictionary growth; it is not the full production knowledge-growth policy.

limits.stop_boundary: Before next indivisible existing search/training/evaluation unit; last unit overrun is measured and reported, incomplete candidate never selected
limits.learning_rate: Controlled methods use .001 or .0005 within the same250 steps; fixed balanced/reference controls retain .001.

resource_policy: Existing 768 MiB work lease, 48 MiB replay graph pool, 32 KiB persistent State, native graph/context/fact/depth/action caps and per-job IO limits remain. Equal ceilings do not imply equal actual compute. Common search and bank construction costs are reported separately; arm CPU includes selection, checking, preparation, training, qualification, serialization and IO bookkeeping. The common implementation uses canonical hex for bounded theorem snapshots, small references to the original owned trace journal, and detached inference inputs. The inference routing preserves model/Adam bytes but may change near-tied float32 rankings; every arm and initial/selected control uses the same frozen routing. Before branching, outer contexts and all adaptive final arms use the same canonical replay eviction to reserve2.5KiB for bounded upper-state metadata inside the original32KiB State cap. This makes their first lower replay inputs identical even though only the learned arm consumes the upper model. The original random-balanced baseline remains unchanged; later data/capacity effects are reported.
qualification: Unchanged positive aggregate development gain, zero original-32 individual solution losses, no earlier anchor loss; all original 96 development cases retained and 24 new development cases appended. Candidate weights AND Adam restored on rejection.
confirmation: All48 outer-training trials and all21 final learning arms complete before any final48-question inference. New final24 whole roots/families exclude all earlier roots/families before variants/noise; native cores gain three composition steps prospectively to address the previous ceiling, without relaxing any native cap. Same10/16/14/8 operation distribution and all original120 development questions. Earlier confirmation outcomes are diagnostic only.

primary.success: Mean gain at least 5 percentage points, no negative seed, paired family-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound greater than zero

bootstrap.groups: 24 whole construction families paired across arms and seeds

secondary: current preparation versus adaptive balanced replay
selected versus exact own initial weights
family/operation regressions and actual CPU/wall/IO costs
retained and candidate updates plus checked replay/source coverage
interpretation: Source-grammar coverage is limited and syntax capability estimates are hypotheses, not universal mathematical difficulty. A positive finite matched result would not establish unbounded autonomous improvement, new calculus completeness, durable multi-round capacity growth, or physical deployment. Negative and incomplete results remain part of the evidence. Development and exact-ID operating checks are distinct from the fresh family confirmation. The common helper recipes condition this study; the new task grammar is not an external mathematics benchmark. Reusing initialization seed 2411 explicitly retests the earlier failure; the two other initialization seeds are new. These are three fixed initializations, not a seed-population confidence interval. Prior held-out diagnostics and exact-replay engineering controls do not qualify new independent performance. Upper-model context transfer is measured on three fixed new lower contexts, not a distribution-free meta-learning theorem. Actual next-plan execution and recovery are separate operating evidence. A negative or inconclusive result is retained without tuning the revealed final questions.

preparation_control.reference: Test-only reference sampler exactly reconstructed from scientific source 9c10e29a; frozen incumbent priorities, family/rule/state weighting, replay only. Never compiled into an ordinary provider.
preparation_control.targeted: Current candidate scores refreshed every existing ten-update unit, success-probability priorities bounded to 1..8 inside fixed origin/family/proof/rule strata; three complete cyclic decision cycles then one focused cycle. Existing checked own/peer anchors rehearsed from their original owned source, deduplicated by job and within the same State/pool/source-byte limits.
preparation_control.balanced: Unchanged prior hierarchical cyclic replay-only comparator.
preparation_control.forensics: All prior confirmation outcomes are retired diagnostic evidence. No diagnostic path or proof extracted from them may enter training or the new confirmation.

preparation_success.success: Mean gain at least 5 percentage points, no negative seed, paired family-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound greater than zero. Additional to the unchanged overall primary condition; no threshold relaxation.
preparation_success.qualification: Direct preparation criterion remains separately assessed; do not call meta loss decrease, activity, a good single seed or neural mechanism tests a quality gain.

outer_meta_learning.lower_trial: Actual fresh initial lower model/Adam and own checker-accepted replay held identical within each context; each independent trial executes original 250 updates and complete 150-unit qualification; selected lower weights are not carried to another outer-training trial. The upper weights and paired Adam carry real positive and negative effects into actual next plan selection.
outer_meta_learning.context_partition: Novel acquisition dependency SHA-256 byte0 modulo3 roles0/1 outer training, role2 final; the seven shared declared prerequisites are excluded from novel acquisition counts. All final lower initializations are held out from outer training.
outer_meta_learning.pilot: Seed3607 one context, two real trials; development only. Pilot weights/experiences never initialize main.
outer_meta_learning.source_capacity: Before fixing each common lower pool, reserve the bounded2.5KiB lossless upper-state metadata plus a prospective full development-profile encoding envelope inside the original32KiB State. All six own-source contexts qualify the unchanged minimum8-example/3-family pool before the first actual trial. The envelope derives only syntax cells, maximum serialized counters/cost and coverage; no hypothetical outcome is observed ability. Each trial uses identical fixed lower sources. Validate the actual reconstructed base before any optimizer update. The first two incomplete main attempts are preserved: omitted profile growth and then insufficient8-source capacity. No final inference occurred; no question, quality threshold, method, memory count or native resource cap changes.

neural_meta_model.architecture: 59 inputs (32 quantized observed context features plus 27 ordered method-composition features), 12 tanh hidden units, three learned heads: checked development gain, protected/anchor forgetting risk, measured lower CPU. Adam .003, eight bounded updates on each actual completed trial, replay up to four whole owned experiences. Binary paired weights/Adam in the existing job artifact owner. The same four complete experiences use lossless typed tuples and canonical phase bits in bounded working State; full named experiences remain in their original owned trial records. No field is discarded.
neural_meta_model.context: Only observed abilities, source structure/origin/size, current retained lower progress, past regressions and past costs; no new trial result, question IDs, seed IDs or truth labels enter prediction inputs.
neural_meta_model.plan_grammar: Three ordered phases of8/9/8 existing lower units; each selects balanced/current-focused data, original replay versus owned-anchor rehearsal, checked successful-action marginal versus up to half pairwise search preference, and LR .001/.0005. 24^3 compositions, not a fixed whole-strategy table.
neural_meta_model.policy: 16 bounded proposals (three fixed anchors and13 generated compositions); neural predicted gain minus predicted forgetting minus .05 predicted normalized lower CPU;20 percent uniform exploration (cold start explores), including untried or previously unsuccessful compositions. Mathematical admission and original resources remain external.
neural_meta_model.costs: Whole-process and per-unit CPU/wall are measured. Lower and meta selection/optimization costs remain separate. Outer trial/common acquisition cost is fully reported and charged to the learned system; equal final lower ceilings are not equal lifetime compute. The regression target is the exact persisted lower CPU/wall through unit149, so restarting a partial final paired write cannot invent a different experience. Final gate and meta CPU/wall remain included in Progress and full process/trial totals.

meta_success.success: For every direct comparison, the same original requirement: mean gain at least5pp, no negative seed, paired24-family bootstrap95percent lower bound strictly positive. Full system success additionally requires the unchanged original primary criterion; added controls do not replace it.
